ROLE: Workhorse formatter (terra), dispatched by the supervisor in the agents-inc repository.
TASK: Format a short draft as Markdown. 1. Read demo/clip/draft.md. 2. Write demo/clip/out/formatted.md: the first line becomes a level-1 heading; the lines Overview, Schedule, Rules and Contacts become level-2 headings in that order; the Overview text stays one paragraph; every line under Schedule, Rules and Contacts becomes one '- ' bullet item. 3. Preserve the draft's wording exactly: do not add, drop, reorder or reword any sentence. 4. Run `python3 demo/clip/check_structure.py demo/clip/out/formatted.md demo/clip/draft.md` and report its output.
CONSTRAINTS: write only demo/clip/out/formatted.md; no commit or push; no network; at most 15 tool calls; keep the draft's wording word for word.
OUT_OF_SCOPE: editing the draft, source notes or checker; correcting facts or wording; any file outside FILES_IN_SCOPE.
STOP_RULE: stop after 2 failed runs of the structure check; report RED with its last output.
FAILURE_GATE: `python3 demo/clip/check_structure.py demo/clip/out/formatted.md demo/clip/draft.md` exits non-zero, or a path outside FILES_IN_SCOPE changed.
